verdict.rationale: Conductor is a multi-agent orchestration/workspace tool for running coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) in parallel with git worktrees, checkpoints, and PR/branch workflows, but nothing in the evidence describes an automated PR-review feature that analyzes diffs and posts contextual review comments. The mentions of 'review path' and 'PR comments' loading refer to workspace/diff viewing and GitHub PR integration, not an automatic code-review capability.
